base_member_text: [L1369-L1385,L1545-L1549] (HIGH/intercommunicator-size) Alltoallw sizes and fills datatype temporaries using local Get_size rather than remote size, producing out-of-bounds accesses for unequal intercommunicator groups.
audit_member_text: [L1369-L1385,L1545-L1548] (HIGH/collective-bounds) Alltoallw sizes and fills datatype arrays using the local Get_size even on intercommunicators, where the arrays must cover the remote group.

adversarial.rationale: Alltoallw belongs to Comm and is inherited by Intercomm, while Comm::Get_size calls MPI_Comm_size (mpicxx.h:1285-1289) and Intercomm separately provides Get_remote_size (1545-1549). No override or intercommunicator branch changes the allocation/iteration counts, so unequal groups cause either backend reads past undersized temporaries or wrapper reads past correctly remote-sized caller arrays.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L2414-L2424] (HIGH/array-bounds) Cartcomm::Sub always reads ten booleans and allocates ten integers regardless of topology dimension, overreading smaller input arrays and undersizing larger topologies.
audit_member_text: [L2414-L2424] (HIGH/bounds) Cartcomm::Sub always reads ten input booleans and allocates ten entries regardless of the actual Cartesian dimension count, causing out-of-bounds reads for smaller input arrays or larger topologies.

adversarial.rationale: Cartcomm::Sub allocates and reads exactly ten entries without calling the available Get_dim (mpicxx.h:2376-2380,2414-2427). The constructors merely wrap communicator handles and impose no ten-dimensional invariant, so a valid one-dimensional bool[1] input is enough to overread before MPI_Cart_sub executes.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L84-L90,L236-L244,L790-L803,L985-L1006,L1371-L1387] (MED/exception-safety) Raw temporary allocations lack exception cleanup, and throwing error handlers skip both deallocation and request/status copyback after MPI has potentially changed them.
audit_member_text: [L236-L244,L830-L851,L985-L1006,L1371-L1387] (MED/exception-safety) Raw temporary arrays are released only after MPI calls and subsequent allocations, so thrown MPI errors or allocation failures bypass cleanup and can also bypass request-handle copyback.

base_member_text: [L1567-L1580,L1658-L1671,L2328-L2341,L2443-L2456] (MED/unchecked-duplication) Clone implementations ignore MPI_Comm_dup status and construct a wrapper from uninitialized ncomm when duplication fails with a returning handler.
audit_member_text: [L1575-L1579,L1666-L1670,L2336-L2340,L2451-L2455] (MED/error-handling) Clone implementations ignore MPI_Comm_dup's return code and construct a communicator from an uninitialized ncomm if duplication fails and the C error handler returns.

adversarial.rationale: The packaged MPICH2 1.4.1p1 runtime explicitly stores MPI_COMM_NULL through newcomm on the error path before returning through the communicator error handler: mpich2mpi.dll RVA 0x6fee0, in cabinet member _1BE96E15F472462586C19E8C77FF7927 of the bundled x64 MSI, disassembled entirely in memory. This matches the quoted upstream error-path assignment, so these Clone calls can discard status but do not construct a wrapper from an uninitialized ncomm with the bundled runtime.

neutralizer.quote:
*newcomm = MPI_COMM_NULL;
    mpi_errno = MPIR_Err_return_comm( comm_ptr, FCNAME, mpi_errno );

adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L323-L332] (MED/uninitialized-read) Datatype::Get_contents copies max_datatypes entries from its temporary rather than the actual datatype count, reading an uninitialized tail when capacity exceeds the envelope count.
audit_member_text: [L323-L332] (MED/uninitialized-read) Get_contents copies max_datatypes entries from an uninitialized temporary even when the datatype contains fewer datatype entries.

adversarial.rationale: MPI_Datatype is typedef int in the companion mpi.h:23, so new MPI_Datatype[v4] does not run a null-initializing wrapper constructor. Get_contents never queries the envelope and copies all capacity entries at mpicxx.h:325-332; extra capacity beyond the actual datatype count remains uninitialized even on success.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L827-L853,L935-L961] (MED/uninitialized-status) Waitsome and Testsome copy every temporary status instead of only the returned completion count, including undefined entries when no requests complete or all are inactive.
audit_member_text: [L827-L851,L935-L959] (MED/uninitialized-read) Waitsome and Testsome copy incount status entries instead of only the returned outcount, reading unwritten temporary statuses when fewer requests complete.

adversarial.rationale: The temporaries are raw MPI_Status structs with integer fields (mpi.h:402-409), not MPI::Status objects with initialization. Waitsome/Testsome copy v1 entries regardless of returned v3, including the all-null-request case where no status entries are produced; request copyback and the separate status-ignoring overloads do not initialize or guard this tail.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L879-L905] (MED/uninitialized-status) Testall copies its uninitialized status temporary even when the returned completion flag is false.
audit_member_text: [L879-L905] (MED/uninitialized-read) Testall copies the temporary status array even when its returned flag is false and the C routine has not defined those statuses.

adversarial.rationale: The complete status-returning Testall overload copies l4 before inspecting v3, with no initialization of the raw MPI_Status array (mpicxx.h:879-905). A false completion flag leaves statuses undefined under the [MPI_Testall contract](https://www.open-mpi.org/doc/v4.0/man3/MPI_Testall.3.php), so neither successful return status nor initialized MPI::Request wrappers neutralize the internal copies.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L409,L1471,L1904] (HIGH/attribute-copy) NULL_COPY_FN sets flag=true without defining attr_out, reporting a successful attribute copy with an indeterminate output pointer.
audit_member_text: [L409,L1471,L1904] (HIGH/attribute-callback) NULL_COPY_FN sets flag=true without initializing attr_out, allowing duplication to install an indeterminate attribute pointer instead of suppressing the copy.

adversarial.rationale: The supplied cxx.lib implementation of each Comm/Datatype/Win Create_keyval compares the copy-function pointer with its NULL_COPY_FN and conditionally replaces it with zero before calling the C registration routine; objdump relocations and the compare/cmove sequence at function offsets 0x4-0x18 verify all three. Thus ordinary registration never executes these helper bodies during duplication, defeating the claimed indeterminate-attribute installation path; the quoted upstream implementation expresses the same concrete neutralizer.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L1690-L1716] (MED/root-only-argument) Spawn_multiple allocates from count and dereferences array_of_info on every rank although these inputs are significant only at root.
audit_member_text: [L1690-L1716] (MED/ignored-argument-access) Both Spawn_multiple overloads copy array_of_info on every rank even though only the root's spawning arguments are significant.

adversarial.rationale: Both complete Spawn_multiple overloads allocate from count and dereference array_of_info before calling the collective, with no Get_rank/root check (mpicxx.h:1690-1719). A nonroot with count>0 and an otherwise insignificant null info-array argument therefore fails in the wrapper before the C implementation can ignore it; providing count=0 on nonroot is only a caller workaround.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L1369-L1385] (MED/ignored-argument-access) Alltoallw dereferences send datatype entries even for an in-place call whose send-side arguments are ignored by the underlying collective.
audit_member_text: [L1373-L1377] (MED/ignored-argument-access) Alltoallw dereferences every send datatype even when MPI_IN_PLACE makes the send-side arguments insignificant.

adversarial.rationale: The inherited Alltoallw implementation always copies v4[i4].the_real_datatype before MPI_Alltoallw, without comparing v1 to MPI_IN_PLACE (mpicxx.h:1369-1388). On a valid in-place intracommunicator call the send-side array may be insignificant, but backend handling occurs too late to protect a null or short send datatype array.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L249-L253,L1185-L1189,L2018-L2022] (LOW/error-path-output) Scalar getters return uninitialized local outputs if the underlying MPI operation fails and the invoked error handler returns normally.
audit_member_text: [L249-L253,L1185-L1189,L2018-L2022] (MED/error-handling) Value-returning wrappers return uninitialized output locals if the MPI call fails and the invoked error handler returns normally.

adversarial.rationale: The scalar outputs v2 have no initializer, and MPIX_CALLWORLD/MPIX_CALLREF call the error handler but do not force a return or throw after it returns (mpicxx.h:83-95,249-253,1185-1189,2018-2022). The claim already requires a returning handler, so default fatal/throwing behavior is not a refutation; unlike communicator duplication, no universal null-output assignment protects these scalar getters.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L2382-L2396] (MED/uninitialized-read) Cartcomm::Get_topo converts maxdims temporary entries to bool instead of the actual dimension count, reading an uninitialized tail for oversized output capacity.
audit_member_text: [L2382-L2396] (MED/uninitialized-read) Cartcomm::Get_topo converts maxdims temporary period entries even when the topology has fewer dimensions.

adversarial.rationale: Get_topo allocates raw int[v2] and converts all v2 entries without consulting Get_dim, even though v2 is only the caller's capacity (mpicxx.h:2376-2398). The topology constructor imposes no capacity-equals-dimension invariant, so a successful one-dimensional topology query with capacity two leaves a converted unwritten tail.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check
